title: ChatCategories
description: The chat → category assignment behind the dashboard timeline colouring (data/output/dashboard/chat-categories.json): a paid model reading of the whole projected corpus, staged to cache/dashboard and validated against this schema before promotion (dashboard.sh, in-memory via validate.py — no per-datum matrix, the markdownConversation precedent). Stored id-keyed so it survives corpus renumbering; presentation re-derives ordinals at injection time (rekey_chats.py). The category → hue palette is a design decision authored in rsc/site/index.html, and category ∈ palette is a cross-file JOIN constraint beyond this schema — the capture checks it separately before promoting.

ChatCategories.title: ChatCategories
ChatCategories.description: A format_table-styled two-column table: conversation ids and their single assigned category.

rows.description: At least one assignment — an empty capture is a failed capture.

items.description: One canonical palette category name (membership checked by the capture as a join constraint).

ConversationId.title: ConversationId
ConversationId.description: The conversation’s source-native id — claude: a v4/v7 uuid; gemini: the 16-hex app id from the conversation URL (no uuids exist there). The identity the corpus keys durable per-conversation data by.
